extra.reason: Proven by committed executable real-server probe (44e68b8): REST/session lifecycle, SSE required events, plugins, fork/fresh inheritance, Git worktree scoping, compaction, restart, and bounded shutdown all verified on Kilo 7.5.6; unsupported SDK/fork assumptions documented with alternatives.

Scaffold committed (0ce44eb): typed src/, executable factory CLI with help/version/unknown handling, Kilo PluginModule export with id 'kilo-factory', noninteractive check gate (typecheck+build+test), 6 unit/artifact tests pass, npm pack dry-run produces 6-file package. No daemon framework introduced.

Typed Kilo adapter committed (c0564af, 1656e00): RestKiloAdapter implements health, listSessions, getSeedConfiguration, createJobSession (fresh from exact seed agent/model/id), promptAsync (parts only, no model overrides), abort, delete, subscribe with idempotent event dedup and reconnect backoff, and close. Uses proven REST/SSE surface with explicit directory scoping per job worktree. 16 unit tests + 3 real-server contract tests pass.

Config + state schema committed (dae75a5): project-agnostic config types (roles, validation, main branch), SQLite-backed durable state store with job generation fencing, state transitions, attempts, failure classification, deterministic upsert/update with stale-generation guard. 8 new tests pass. DB is project-local and reconstructible.

Beads backend adapter committed (6d96943): BeadsCliBackend uses JSON CLI output for ready/show/claim/update/close. Core scheduler parses structured JSON. Ready excludes epics. Idempotent operations reconcile on failure. 10 unit tests cover malformed JSON, empty results, and races.

Worktree manager committed (6f9f96b): GitWorktreeManager creates/inspects/cleans job-isolated worktrees with factory/<jobId>/<generation> branches. Dirty work never force-reset. Cleanup refuses unknown/unowned. Deterministic unique commit detection. 3 unit tests + contract tests pass.

Coordinator FSM committed (09e8ad7): reconciliation-based lifecycle with explicit state machine, monotonic generation fencing, bounded retries, failure classification. Legal transitions encoded, illegal fail closed. Idempotent across restart. No blind redispatch. 12 new tests pass.

Version/capability guard committed (a7af470): detects unsupported Kilo versions early, checks required API/plugin capabilities, fails with actionable diagnostics, feature-gates experimental hooks. 4 unit tests pass.

Plugin contract committed (bf909ed): validates job identity and generation for completion/block payloads, rejects stale generations and job mismatches, structured machine-readable tools. 5 unit tests pass.

Artifact verifier committed (4e9a8cd): independently verifies plugin completion claims against Git and durable state. Rejects wrong job/generation/SHA/dirty contradictions. Stale generations never reach integration. 4 unit tests pass.

Context builder committed (f1c4e51): builds task context with stable contract + project instructions + role contract + exact job envelope. Unrelated bead IDs excluded. Job id/generation authoritative. Stable/dynamic separated. 5 unit tests pass.

Idle continuation committed (0e3479e): session.idle is observation not completion, configurable continuation budget, repeated idle without progress becomes quarantine, no polling storm or duplicate prompts. 6 unit tests pass.

Contamination regression suite committed (0ab4b7a): old task IDs can't override identity, wrong-generation completion rejected, recovery preserves identity, unrelated tasks absent from context. 5 regression tests pass.
Integration pipeline committed (f006f3b): validates candidate branch and integration inputs, validation failure leaves main unchanged, single deterministic writer. 3 unit tests pass.

Session workflow committed (2164690): CLI prints copyable attach instructions for every role, manual model selection preserved, seed sessions not reused as cross-task memory, arbitrary role count. 5 unit tests pass.

CLI dispatcher committed (46d810d): extensible command structure for init/start/sessions/status/inspect/pause/resume/stop/doctor. Commands register and dispatch with proper error handling. 5 unit tests pass.

Crash/reboot reconciliation implemented and committed (be1bf0e). Reconciles SQLite state with observed Git/Beads/Kilo state. Clean work retries, dirty work enters bounded recovery, unique commits recovered as candidates, unknown state quarantined. 6 unit tests pass.
Process/session ownership hardening implemented and committed (b762395). ProcessTracker registers factory-owned server/session processes. Unrelated Kilo processes never killed. 4 unit tests pass.
Structured event log and status views implemented and committed (7f0c911). EventLogger durably logs state transitions. Secrets auto-redacted. Events filterable by job ID and level. 4 unit tests pass.

Audit complete. Discrepancy explained: beads 015, 016, 019 were committed in previous session but Beads status left as in_progress; all three now closed with evidence. 018 (fault-injection) and 020 (packaging) now ready. Production beads 025-033 blocked by audit dependencies. DAG coherent.
Packaging committed (ddbf996): package manifest exposes plugin entrypoint, factory init creates project config in .kilo-factory/ without copying source, end-to-end tested. 111 tests pass.

Fault-injection matrix committed (2b23586): 12 regression tests covering coordinator death, stale generations, duplicate completion, dirty worktrees, process ownership, unbounded redispatch prevention. Fixed critical orphan process defect in contract tests. 123 tests pass.
E2E scaffold committed (635552d): lifecycle test with fixture setup, runs when KILO_E2E_SEED_SESSION_ID set. Full lifecycle verification requires live Kilo environment with seed session.

SQLite durability audit committed (7b08f74): fresh init deterministic, schema version tracked, retry can't double-complete, stale generation rejected, upsert idempotent, state survives restart. 6 tests pass.

Adversarial recovery tests committed (152594a): worker death can't complete, stale generations rejected, dirty worktrees preserved, integration validated before promotion, bounded recovery. 6 tests pass.

Security audit committed (9d4b9f9): positive ownership for cleanup, PID reuse safety, foreign processes not tracked, worktree validation, stale completion rejected, injection prevention. 8 tests pass.
Soak tests committed (62b38f9): concurrent roles without contamination, no duplicate accumulation, bounded growth, factory functional after soak. 4 tests pass.
Operations guide committed (c91dd50): installation, init, role config, seed sessions, operation, stop semantics, recovery, troubleshooting. No project-specific roles.
Self-host scaffold committed (1cf3a1e): fixture creation, factory binary, init verified. Full dogfood execution requires live Kilo seed session (KILO_SELFHOST_SEED_SESSION_ID).
